data.body: Cross-model adversarial review of the P1-P9 plan complete (Bedrock: DeepSeek v3.2, gpt-oss-120b, Mistral Large 3; raw outputs X4-X6). Synthesis: 10-bedrock-adversarial-review.md. Convergent findings accepted with amendments: (F1) P4 review-comment mechanism-delta will not enforce - replaced with a deterministic mechanism-delta ratchet in make lint/Verified lane, shrink-only budget in the complexity-baseline pattern; C5 additive bias upgraded amplifier->co-engine. (F2) P1's INDETERMINATE handling treated a resource/budget-exhaustion signal as a display problem - added a per-gate resource-budget guard with distinct RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED status (exit: <=2 pct of runs for 2 consecutive weeks), a verdict-cache spec with formula-version invalidation, and a mechanism-read of actual 19.9 pct flip cases before further judge work. (F3) P5's replacement freshness predicate is a proposal not code - stage 0 now designs+validates it with its own oracle; store criticality decoupled from its 5 pct defect share (PASS-but-unsigned is critical-path; live wedge avoided-flannel-eeve same day). (F4) new P10: upstream defect-introduction measurement (rework vs change size; mechanism-read of the doubling CI-at-landing and environment friction categories) before any enforcement. (F5) plan restructured into two parallel tracks: Track I introduction reducers (P2, P3+subprocess isolation, P4-deterministic, P10), Track II loop integrity (P1 amended, P5 staged); P6-P9 background. Rejected reviewer claims documented with reasons incl. one fabricated citation (Mistral) and two staging misreads - convergence-then-verify held.
